'''Adrona''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Imperial Prefect|Prefect]] serving the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. She was impressed by [[Moxin Tark]]'s capture of [[Tellas Lordin]] and allowed [[Expeditor]] [[Minas Derel]] to renew Tark's [[Sector Permit]] for only three hundred [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] after gifting her a case of [[Hestrian wine]].<ref name="MIH" />
